claim.fill: the checkable claim inside the submission

text.fill: the passage the submission supplies for analysis

address.fill: 0x account, contract or ENS name parsed from the claim

chain.fill: chain name parsed from the claim, default ethereum

chainId.fill: numeric chain id for the named chain

url.fill: absolute URL parsed from the claim

domain.fill: hostname parsed from the claim or from the URL

ip.fill: IPv4 or IPv6 literal parsed from the claim

symbol.fill: ticker or asset name parsed from the claim

coinId.fill: CoinGecko id for the named asset

location.fill: place name parsed from the claim

protocol.fill: DeFi protocol slug parsed from the claim

hours.fill: hour window stated in the claim

days.fill: day window stated in the claim

cveId.reason: 4 CVE miners pattern-check the id, so {{query}} cannot reach them

lat.reason: coordinate-only weather miners declare no place name

lon.reason: coordinate-only weather miners declare no place name

targetLang.fill: target language named in the claim
targetLang.reason: translation miners need the target separately from the text

sourceLang.fill: source language, when the claim names one

langPair.reason: MyMemory-shaped miners take one packed pair

fromCurrency.fill: ISO 4217 base code parsed from the claim
fromCurrency.reason: FX miners take the pair as two codes, not as prose

toCurrency.fill: ISO 4217 quote code parsed from the claim

rules.endpoint: an endpoint whose description names the intent wins; then a path word match; then a description word match; then the only functional endpoint. health, metrics, meta, docs and root paths are never routed, nor is any endpoint whose description says it is not an intent target
rules.slots: each declared param is read off input_schema: its own description first (q means a city to one miner and the text to translate to another), then its declared pattern, then its name. A param whose description names other endpoints is only sent to those. An unmapped required param sends the pair to needs_review instead of guessing
rules.required: required when input_schema.required lists it, when it is a path parameter, or when its description scopes it to this endpoint. An explicit optional, default or when-omitted clause overrides that
